question: Which of the following boxers won the bronze medal in the 69 kg welterweight semifinals at Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympics on 4 August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lovlina Borgohain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• She lost to reigning world champion** Busenaz Surmeneli** on 4 August 2021.
 
• She is only the **third Indian boxer** to ensure a podium finish after** Vijender Singh **(**2008**) and** M C Mary Kom** (**2012**).
 
• Hers is also the first Olympic medal in Indian boxing in nine years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympics**__

 __
 
• Tokyo 2020 has revealed the official Games Motto,** “United by Emotion”**.
 
• This is the second time the Olympics games were held in** Tokyo**, earlier it was in **1964**.
 
• The **official mascot **of the** Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympic** Games was set to be a smiling, futuristic creature named** Miraitowa**.
